why:
BLEACH: Thousand-Year Blood War Part 4, The Calamity, is the ten episode summer 2026 cour running 2026-07-25 to 2026-09-26 in a weekly 14:00 slot.
anizip:19079 is the same run: the same ten episode count, and its own SAME_AS ids name mal:60636 and anilist:185874, both members.
cr:GT00384448-GS00384452 is the same run: it maps SAME_AS to anilist:185874, kitsu:49444, mal:60636, offline:mal-60636 and anizip:19079, and its seven aired episodes sit on the run's own dates, 2026-07-25, 2026-08-01, 2026-08-08, 2026-08-15, 2026-08-22, 2026-08-29 and 2026-09-05, with the same titles in upper case.
hulu:bleach-thousand-year-blood-war-02a3c8c0-4f1d-4610-bbb4-5b8e9468d7b1 holds the run: a bare Hulu series container with no title, count or dates, named by kitsu:49444 as PART_OF.
nf:70204957 holds the run: the Netflix container for Bleach as a whole, starting 2004 and listing hundreds of episodes from Episode 1 onward across every arc, so it is the franchise rather than this cour.
The Crunchyroll episodes 41 to 47 pair with anizip:19079 episodes 1 to 7 on identical release dates.
The kitsu episodes 1, 2, 3, 4, 6, 7 and 8 pair with the same numbered anizip:19079 episodes on exact titles: God of Thunder, Son of Darkness, Blood for My Bone, The Perfect Crimson, The End, The End 2 and The End Two World.
